title: Ribbon Levels for Navbar Tabs and Window Toolbar
description: Expand the design language with ribbon levels: a ribbon strip that grows by stacked lines, one per tree level. Navbar shrinks to two toggles (left/right side panel visibility); the former panel-kind categories (workbench/display, details/settings) become the top tab row of each side panel, with plugin tabs as a row below — tabs are now a tree, arbitrarily nestable (plugin schema becomes recursive too). Window toolbar tool-group nodes expand the ribbon upward (one stacked line per pressed group, sibling press replaces rows above). Footer keeps its inline horizontal drill-down (no vertical room to grow).
